name: LLM optimization pipeline for standard laptops

mentions.name: LLM optimization pipeline for standard laptops
mentions.description: An optimization pipeline for LLMs that enables large language models to run on a standard laptop; its first prototype ran an 80B model at full 256k context at 40 tokens/s while using only 14GB of RAM.
mentions.problem: Large language models are too resource-heavy to run on a standard laptop.
mentions.source_excerpt:
We developed a novel optimization pipeline for LLMs so large models can run on a standard laptop.

Our first prototype optimized an 80B model to run at full 256k context at 40 tokens/s while only taking up 14gb of RAM.
